name: Scientific paper
description: A compact manuscript opening, a distinct abstract, and a continuous reading column with clear figures, tables, and references. For research manuscripts, preprints, and scholarly notes.
structure: A centered title, author line, and optional affiliations share the first page with the manuscript.
An optional inset abstract and keywords separate the summary from the main text without a cover page.
Compact heading levels organize a continuous single column. Figures and tables sit in the author's chosen reading order.
Cited references follow the body and page numbers sit centrally below. The layout is adaptable and does not prescribe a journal style or section outline.
